The problem

One couple answers the same question forty times.

40guests flying in
5languages
1couple, on WhatsApp

Nine months of it. By the thirtieth message, Elena is guessing at a shuttle time she hasn't checked.

What is actually new

They publish information.
Bells answers questions.

ProductWhat it does
Zola · The KnotRegistry, website, RSVP. Travel is a page the couple type.
WithJoyHas an AI assistant — it helps the couple write content.
Appy Couple · MintedBeautiful static itineraries. A guest reads; they don't ask.
  • Solves arrival logistics instead of listing them
  • Answers each guest in the language they wrote in
  • Escalates instead of guessing — then never asks twice

All five are more complete products than mine. The claim is narrow, not that Bells is better.

What's next

Three things, in order.

1 Pilot one real wedding

Every number here is from one seeded wedding and my own testing. No real guest has used it yet.

2 Wire real messaging

Drafts exist in five languages. Nothing sends — on purpose. A provider behind the same approval step.

3 Add the seating solver

Written, not wired in. Same pattern as the shuttles: Python solves, the agent explains.
